title: Forty-one Replies in One Afternoon
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：type　|　正文 389 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 type 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The summer I turned eighteen I was paid to type. Not to think — to ① type: two hundred questionnaires, four pages each, into a machine that could not spell. It was the least ② typical job I have ever had, and the most instructive in type, and the most useful, because it taught me what a number is made of before anybody has drawn a graph from it.

The survey asked people what ③ type of food they bought and how often. There were nine answers printed on the form and a tenth box marked 'other', which is where everything interesting went. Most people, I found, do not know what ④ type of thing they are being asked about until they have answered it wrongly once, and by then they have answered it.

The machine sorted by ⑤ type and could not sort by anything else, so a woman who wrote 'beans, but only on Fridays' became a bean-eater seven days a week. My own habit, formed that summer and never broken, was to ⑥ type the 'other' answers out in full and put them in a separate file. Typing, I discovered, is a way of reading slowly. It was not in my instructions, and it doubled my hours, and it was the only part of the work that survived. Nobody had asked for that file, and nobody had forbidden it either.

Dr Shah read that file in September. She said the ⑦ type of error I had found — people answering the question they expected rather than the one printed — has a name in her field, and that a statistician who has never ⑧ typed two hundred questionnaires set in nine-point type has no business drawing conclusions from them. She then did something I have never forgotten: she rang eleven of the 'other' households and asked them what they had meant.

The report came out in November with one paragraph about beans on Fridays, and that paragraph was quoted in a newspaper and in a parliamentary debate, and it came entirely from the file I was not asked to keep. ⑨ Type, I learned at eighteen, is a way of deciding what can be counted; the decision is made long before the counting, usually by somebody who has never met a ⑩ type of person like the woman with the beans, and usually without asking her.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. v. 打字；输入（type sth）
B. n. 类型；种类（a type of）
E. v. 按类型归类；分型
F. 固定搭配：what type of ... 什么类型的……
G. n. （某类）人；家伙（a type of person）
H. 固定搭配：sort by type 按类型分类

items.q: It was the least typical job
what type of food they bought
what type of thing they are being asked about
to type the 'other' answers out in full
the type of error I had found
typed two hundred questionnaires set in nine-point type
a type of person like the woman with the beans

answers.why: 动词，意为“打字、录入”，指把两百份问卷敲进机器。
typical 意为“典型的”，说这份工作是最不像样的一份，却最有用。
what type of ... 是固定问法，意为“什么类型的……”，此处问买哪一类食品。
同样是 what type of 问法，说多数人要答错一次才明白被问的是什么。
sort by type 意为“按类型分类”，说机器只能这样分类。
动词，指把“其他”栏的答案完整“打出来”另存一份。
指错误的“类型、种类”，即人们答的是自己预期的问题。
nine-point type 指“九号字体”，type 作名词表印刷字体、字号。
此处 type 抽象为“归类、定类型”的行为，说它决定了什么能被计数。
a type of person 意为“某一类人”，指那位只在周五吃豆子的女士那样的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 那个夏天我的工作是把两百份问卷打进机器。（type v.）
问卷问人们买哪一类食品。（what type of）
机器只能按类型分类，别的都不会。（sort by type）
我把“其他”栏的答案完整地打出来另存一份。（type v.）
从未亲手录入过问卷的人不该据此下结论。（type v.）
做决定的人从未见过像那位女士那样的一类人。（a type of person）
answers: That summer my job was to type two hundred questionnaires into a machine.
The survey asked people what type of food they bought.
The machine could sort by type and by nothing else.
I typed the 'other' answers out in full and put them in a separate file.
Nobody who has never typed a questionnaire should draw conclusions from one.
The people who decide have never met a type of person like that woman.
